notes: Hand traced on unchanged Chamber_05.jpeg at 1536x1024 top-left pixels, after full-image and enlarged coordinate crops of the northwest terrace, ring west edge, center route, southeast court and arch thresholds. Main floor follows stone slab ground contacts, independent of the tall painted silhouettes.

The supported connected surface is the upper-west terrace, diagonal ring causeway, southeast court and the connected top cap of the lower-right arch threshold. Broad lava rivers and vertical cliff faces are excluded. Fine glowing seams among contiguous slabs are surface cracks; the broad flowing channels are not traversable.

The rough-catalog west exit at (105,381) is on a disconnected arch apron. A bright lava channel separates that apron from the terrace near x180..205, y300..435; no walkable bridge is painted. It is excluded and its reachable replacement is the upper-west arch stone threshold/approach at (382,310). Return spawn is interior paving at (349,359). This is a material door placement limitation of the source, not an invented lava bridge.

Upper northern arch platforms and the far-east ruin are disconnected across lava falls. They are scenic background and outside the main navigation polygon. Main occluders and close foreground isolated pillars remain separately traced where they visually overlap the reachable floor.

The west foreground column stands on a lava-separated promontory near (425,749), and the lower foreground column extends to a cliff base near (877,949). Their bases do not consume the walkable stone visible behind their shafts. Main paving behind them is retained for correct player occlusion.

Raised bases, broken wall rubble, fallen lintels, basalt ridges and tree roots use compact ground-contact polygons. Their independent silhouettes include the complete visible shaft, cap, branches, flame/bowl or sloping rubble face. Arch pier/lintel silhouettes are separate to preserve open windows. Overhead lintel collision is contained inside a supporting pier footprint.

The southeast exit/return trigger at (1373,898) lies on the visible top stone cap between the arrival arch piers. The vertical fascia below that cap is excluded, as is the bottom-right stone tail beyond its drop/steps. That tail is not assumed reachable by the current movement model. Arrival (1172,864) is inside the court, away from raised rubble and the brazier. Encounter and enemy spawns use connected painted paving.

Confidence: distinct slab/lava boundaries and pier/plinth contacts approximately 5-10 pixels; dark broken rim and partly hidden floor around foreground pillars 10-18 pixels; individual dead branches 3-6 pixels. Floor hidden behind pillars is interpolated only between contiguous visible paving. No source painting, scene, layout asset or shared code was changed.
